reviews.title: Broken and no fix for months
reviews.text:
I loved turbo AI. It was genuinely the only study tool I've used that actually worked. That was until June. They did system updates that affected the user interface and there is no longer an option to add documents or files to folders. You can only create a temporary lesson with their bot, yet it will be erased as soon as you leave the lesson.

I've sent countless emails, first making sure they were aware of the problem. It was ignored. I sent a follow up email asking to be refunded for the 3 months where Turbo AI was not delivering on the main features it promised. It was ignored. 

It's so upsetting to have to let this app go because of how useful it was, but at this point I've spent $60 waiting for it to get fixed and it hasn't, meanwhile the App Store says they're performing "bug fixes" frequently yet this MAJOR issue has not been fixed for months.

Why would I pay $20 a month for "lessons" by their AI bot when nothing gets saved, you can't go back to it, and features are promised that they can't deliver.

reviews.title: Recent update no longer serves my needs
reviews.text:
I loved this app. I used it to capture sermon notes every Sunday. It would record the  sermon and then create amazing notes based on the recording.

Not only did it capture what was said, but also delved deeper and became a valuable study aid.

Several Sundays ago, I noticed the app’s design had changed. I wasn’t easily  able to record. The app actually stopped or lost the recording a couple of times.

Today, I attempted to record per usual. It recorded. I clicked finalize. Nothing happened. It then presented a “new lesson” option. I selected it thinking it would pull my audio into the new lesson.

It did not. It offered “Newton’s Law of Gravity” instead.

My audio was lost and cannot be replaced. I’m sorely disappointed. My subscription expires this month. I was excited to renew and have recommended this app several times before. Unfortunately, I will not be able to continue to do so or renew.
